founder.name: Subhani Abdul
founder.background: Ex-Indian Navy Vet & Certified Security Practitioner
founder.quote: Our mission is simple: to keep your business running smoothly by providing premium, in-house, compliant property management services. We don't rely on third-party subcontracts; our 15,000+ professionals are our own family.
founder.bio: Subhani Abdul founded Action Group in 2001 following a distinguished career in the Indian Navy. With extensive certifications in security management and infrastructure services, he envisioned a premium, self-performing property services brand that honors compliance and fair wages as much as technical excellence.

headquarters.address: Action Group House, Phase 2, HITEC City, Hyderabad, 500081

milestones.title: Action Group Inception
milestones.description: Founded by Subhani Abdul with a primary focus on corporate guarding and security operations in Hyderabad.

milestones.title: Facility Management Integration
milestones.description: Expanded into integrated housekeeping and MEP services, launching the Amaze PMS division.

milestones.title: Pan-India Expansion
milestones.description: Secured major contracts in Bangalore, Chennai, and Mumbai, scaling the workforce to 5,000+ professionals.

milestones.title: Bespoke Technical Operations
milestones.description: Launched high-end STP/WTP operation cells and corporate cost-audit optimization divisions.

milestones.title: 15,000 Professionals Milestone
milestones.description: Ranked among India's largest self-performing facility operators, serving 20M+ sq ft.

milestones.title: Digital Facility Transformation
milestones.description: Integrating environmental sustainability goals and IoT remote monitoring diagnostics across managed portfolios.

values.title: 100% In-House Capability
values.description: We recruit, train, and pay our staff directly. No subcontracting, no diluted standards, and full accountability.

values.title: Absolute Statutory Compliance
values.description: Ethical employee welfare is core. 100% compliance with PF, ESIC, minimum wages, and safety insurance.

values.title: Technical Innovation

values.title: Certified Security Mindset
values.description: Rooted in military precision and risk auditing to guarantee asset, data, and human protection.
